title: Normalization and completion of a reduced local algebraic curve
statement: Let $k$ be a field and let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a reduced local $k$-algebra, meaning that $a^n=0$ with $n\geq1$ implies $a=0$. Assume $A$ is essentially of finite type over $k$ [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] and has Krull dimension $1$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Let $Q(A)$ be the localization of $A$ obtained by inverting every non-zero-divisor (an element $s$ for which $sa=0$ implies $a=0$), and let $B\subset Q(A)$ be the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] of $A$ in $Q(A)$. Write $\widehat A=\varprojlim_n A/\mathfrak m^n$ for its completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Tensor products mean extension of scalars [def-weil-module-base-change]. Then $B$ is a finite $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], $\widehat A$ is reduced of dimension $1$, and the canonical map identifies $B\otimes_A\widehat A$ with the integral closure of $\widehat A$ in $Q(\widehat A)$. Here the map to $Q(\widehat A)$ extends $A\to\widehat A$ and sends the denominator of any element of $Q(A)$ to the same denominator in $\widehat A$.
